asset_evidence_fk_exclusive_chk.name: asset_evidence_fk_exclusive_chk
asset_evidence_fk_exclusive_chk.value: ("asset_evidence"."cve_id" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_evidence"."mitre_technique_id" IS NULL AND "asset_evidence"."expectation_type" IS NULL) OR ("asset_evidence"."cve_id" IS NULL AND "asset_evidence"."mitre_technique_id" IS NOT NULL AND "asset_evidence"."expectation_type" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_idempotency_idx.name: jobs_idempotency_idx
jobs_idempotency_idx.where: idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('queued', 'running')

job_schedules_at_minute_ck.name: job_schedules_at_minute_ck
job_schedules_at_minute_ck.value: (at_minute IS NOT NULL) = (cadence IN ('daily', 'weekly')) AND (at_minute IS NULL OR at_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)

job_schedules_weekday_ck.name: job_schedules_weekday_ck
job_schedules_weekday_ck.value: (weekday IS NOT NULL) = (cadence = 'weekly') AND (weekday IS NULL OR weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6)
